_llm_instructions: قم بتعبئة 'project_title' و 'date_prepared'، بالإضافة إلى خصائص 'value' لكل حقل في نموذج تقييم أداء الفريق هذا بناءً على سياق المشروع.

النطاق.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to deliver the scope of the project and product. Provide comments that describe instances or aspects of scope performance that justify the rating.

الجودة.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to deliver the quality required of the project and product. Provide comments that describe instances or aspects of quality performance that justify the rating.

الجدول الزمني.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to deliver on schedule. Provide comments that describe instances or aspects of schedule performance that justify the rating.

التكلفة.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to deliver within budget. Provide comments that describe instances or aspects of cost performance that justify the rating.

Communication.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to communicate effectively. Provide comments that illustrate instances of communication that justify the rating.

Collaboration.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to collaborate effectively. Provide comments that illustrate instances of collaboration that justify the rating.

Conflict management.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to manage conflict effectively. Provide comments that illustrate instances of conflict management that justify the rating.

Decision making.guidance: Rate the team’s ability to make decisions effectively. Provide comments that illustrate instances of decision making that justify the rating.

Area.guidance: List technical or interpersonal areas for development.

Approach.guidance: Describe the development approach, such as training, mentoring, or coaching.

Actions.guidance: List the actions necessary to implement the development approach.
